summary: @servicetitan/react-hooks 7.7.3 ships an install-time Bun-dropper executing an obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub oven-sh releases, extracts it, chmod +x's the binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js on `npm install`. math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-flagged script (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) built from an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW`), an ~1200-entry mixed numeric/string decode table (`n7gIxM`), and a character-lookup decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — the payload the preinstall runs under Bun rather than Node. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root even though package.json restricts published files to `["dist","src"]`, so the dropper and payload are smuggled outside the declared file manifest. Executing a second language runtime and a large obfuscated script at install time is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (a React hooks library) and constitutes attacker-controlled code execution on any machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
